detail.longDescription: Inside PH4NTXM: #15 Lone Wolf DHCP A local lease request can advertise more identity than it needs to. Lonewolf prepares a minimal DHCP configuration before network setup. It preserves the protected session MAC and disables hostname advertisement, while the architecture omits vendor-class advertisement for this mode. NetworkManager defaults, dhclient configuration, and the session record follow that profile. The dispatcher consumes the record for active-device updates; a failed Lonewolf update disconnects the device. Local network setup remains necessary, with a narrower set of advertised identity fields. # ph4ntxm # linux # debian # os # live # privacy # security # opsec # infosec # research # tech # technology
